**Neumora Therapeutics (NASDAQ: NMRA)** announced significant leadership changes effective February 14, 2025. Paul L. Berns, co-founder and executive chair, will become CEO and chairman of the Board, replacing Henry Gosebruch. Joshua Pinto, Ph.D., will serve as president, Bill Aurora, Pharm.D., as chief operating and development officer, and Michael Milligan as chief financial officer.

The clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company has **seven clinical and pre-clinical brain disease programs** in its pipeline, with clinical data readouts expected from all three clinical-stage programs in 2025. A key highlight is the ongoing Phase 3 program with navacaprant in depression.

...

The pipeline is complimented by a world class team of neuroscience drug developers and company builders and is supported by a strong financial foundation.

“Neumora is poised to reach its potential, working to maximize shareholder value, and most importantly, to make a difference for the millions of people living with brain diseases,” said Paul L. Berns. “We have seven novel neuroscience programs in the pipeline and four clinical data readouts on the horizon, including data from the ongoing Phase 3 program with navacaprant in depression. This provides significant opportunities to improve the treatment of brain diseases and address unmet needs by bringing novel medicines to people who need them most.”

“On behalf of the Board, I would like to thank Henry for his contributions to Neumora and important capabilities created at the Company. We wish him all the best in the future,” Mr. Berns continued.

“I am honored to serve as president of Neumora,” said Dr. Joshua Pinto.

...

### Who is the new CEO of Neumora (NMRA) and when does the transition take effect?

Paul L. Berns, previously executive chair of the Board, will become CEO and chairman of the Board effective February 14, 2025.

### How many clinical programs does Neumora (NMRA) have in development?

Neumora has seven clinical and pre-clinical brain disease programs in its pipeline, with three programs currently in clinical stages.

### What are the key clinical milestones expected for Neumora (NMRA) in 2025?

Neumora expects clinical data readouts from all three of its clinical-stage programs in 2025, including data from the Phase 3 program with navacaprant in depression.

On August 14, 2026, Neumora Therapeutics, Inc. submitted a Form 8-K to the SEC announcing a change in its chief executive leadership and reporting its financial performance for the quarter ending June 30, 2026.

### Key Highlights

* **CEO Change Effective August 14, 2026:** Joshua Pinto, Ph.D., previously the company’s President, took over as Chief Executive Officer from Paul L. Berns on this date.
* **Executive Chairperson Appointment:** Paul L. Berns transitioned to Executive Chairperson of the Board of Directors following the CEO change.
* **Dual Leadership Role:** Dr. Pinto will maintain his position as President in addition to serving as CEO.
* **Board Membership:** The Board appointed Dr.
Pinto as a Class III director effective August 14, 2026, with a term lasting until the 2029 Annual Meeting of Stockholders.
* **Board Approval Date:** Both the leadership transition and Dr. Pinto’s board appointment were approved on August 12, 2026.
* **Q2 2026 Financial Results:** The company released its financial results for the quarter ending June 30, 2026, with the full details included as Exhibit 99.1.

## Neumora Therapeutics Announces CEO Transition and Q2 2026 Earnings

Neumora Therapeutics, Inc. [(NASDAQ:NMRA)](https://kalkinemedia.com/us/companies/nasdaq-nmra) [NMRA (NASDAQ:NMRA)](https://kalkinemedia.com/us/companies/nasdaq-nmra) , headquartered at 260 Arsenal Place, Suite 1, Watertown, Massachusetts 02472, revealed two major updates in its August 14, 2026 filing. Joshua Pinto, Ph.D., who was serving as President, was named Chief Executive Officer, succeeding Paul L. Berns. Mr. Berns assumed the role of Executive Chairperson of the Board of Directors.
This leadership change was effective as of August 14, 2026, referred to as the "Transition Date" in the filing.

The Board of Directors approved this leadership transition on August 12, 2026, two days prior to its effective date. Concurrently, the Board appointed Dr. Pinto as a Class III director, with a term expiring at the 2029 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Dr. Pinto will continue in this role until a successor is elected or until his earlier death, resignation, or removal. His prior professional background is detailed in the company’s Definitive Proxy Statement on Schedule 14A filed April 17, 2026.

Additionally, under Item 2.02 of the filing, Neumora disclosed its financial results for the second quarter ending June 30, 2026. The full press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. The filing clarifies that the information under Item 2.02, including Exhibit 99.1, is not considered "filed" under Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
The Form 8-K was signed by Michael Milligan, Chief Financial Officer, on August 14, 2026.

## Summary of Disclosures

Neumora Therapeutics announced the appointment of Joshua Pinto, Ph.D. as CEO effective August 14, 2026, with Paul L. Berns moving to Executive Chairperson, alongside the release of its second quarter 2026 financial results provided as an exhibit.
